description: PAID $0.25 USDC. Everything in binance_flows plus the biggest single withdrawals in 24h (tx hash, block, time, USD, recipient), destination labels where identifiable (other exchanges, bridges, else unlabeled), destination breakdown, hourly net-flow series and the tracked wallet list with sources. Returns the binance_flows snapshot plus the largest 24h withdrawals, destination labels, an hourly net-flow series, and the tracked wallet list.

api_key.description: Optional payment credential. Format: a prepaid key sk_scrapling_... or a catalog pass token sdp_... from pass_day or pass_month. Example: sdp_... . When omitted on a paid tool, the call is unpaid and the server answers with x402 PaymentRequired; retry the same call with the signed payment in params._meta['x402/payment'].

limit.description: How many of the biggest withdrawals to list. Format: integer from 1 to 100. Example: 25. Default: 25, as the existing tool text states.

name: binance_flows_report
title: Binance outflow report: biggest withdrawals and destinations ($0.25)
